fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields parsed from plain HTML and <meta> tags -- fijitimes.com.fj emits no ld+json of any kind. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, from the newest post-sitemap*.xml since /feed/ redirects to the homepage) carry link/lastmod-style fields with no title (this site has no Yoast News sitemap).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the h1.fijitimes_title HTML element.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from div.entry-content.post_content > p paragraphs.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of WordPress category names the article is tagged with (e.g. ['Local News', 'News', "Today's Main Story"]).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL of a latest-mode sitemap listing item.

lastmod.title: Last modified (sitemap)
lastmod.description: ISO 8601 <lastmod> timestamp from the post sitemap entry -- not a true publish date (this generic Yoast sitemap carries no title or publish timestamp). Fetch the article in article mode for the exact datePublished.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
